question: What bodily signs mark the person whose sanctity is being praised?
premises: Rudrākṣa is present on the body
The triple mark is present on the forehead
These signs belong to a particular person
inference: The person marked by rudrākṣa on the body and the triple mark on the forehead is distinguished.
uncertainties: The main predicate describing this person is completed in the next verse.
plain_english: He on whose body there is rudrākṣa and on whose forehead the triple mark.
